# help createfilesystem
createfilesystem - create a filesystem of a specified size.

SYNTAX
    createfilesystem [-tpvv|-reduce] <name> <size>[g|G|t|T]

DESCRIPTION
    The createfilesystem command creates a filesystem for NFS protocols
     of specified size and name.

AUTHORITY
    Super, Edit
    Any role granted the filesystem_create right

OPTIONS
    -reduce
        Specifies that the filesystem should use thin provisioning with compression
        and dedup technologies. This is the default option.

     -tpvv
        Specifies that the filesystem should use thin provisioning only.

SPECIFIERS
    <name>
        Specifies a filesystem name up to 255 characters in length.

    <size>[g|G|t|T]
        Specifies the size for the filesystem in MB.
        The size is rounded up to the next multiple of 256 MB. The size must be an integer.

NOTES
    Verify the creation of filesystem by issuing the showfilesystem command.

    Maximum size of filesystem is 64 TiB.

EXAMPLES
    Creating a 10G filesystem named demo_fs which would use thin provisioning capability

        cli% createfilesystem demo_fs 10g

    Creating a 10G filesystem named demo_fs which would use thin provisioning capability
    with compression and dedup technologies.

        cli% createfilesystem -reduce demo_fs 10g
